summary: Warm-season crop; stake plants and manage blight in humid Terai.

guides.title: Seedling bed
guides.body: Sow in raised beds with compost. Harden seedlings 7 days before transplant. Keep moist, not waterlogged.

guides.title: Field planting
guides.body: Space 45×60 cm. Apply well-rotted FYM. Mulch to reduce weeds. Irrigate every 3–4 days in dry season.

guides.title: Fruit set
guides.body: Side-dress compost tea or balanced NPK lightly. Remove lower leaves touching soil. Scout for leaf miner and blight.

guides.title: Pick at breaker stage
guides.body: Harvest when 30% pink for local market; fully red for immediate sale. Sort damaged fruit daily.

summary: Use certified seed tubers; hill soil at 15–20 cm height.

guides.title: Seed tubers
guides.body: Cut large tubers with 2–3 eyes. Treat with wood ash. Plant 10 cm deep in ridges after pre-monsoon rain.

guides.title: Hilling
guides.body: Earthing up when plants are 15–20 cm protects tubers from greening and supports root growth.

guides.title: Water & pests
guides.body: Maintain even soil moisture. Watch for late blight in cloudy humid weeks—remove affected tops early.

guides.title: Cure & store
guides.body: Harvest when vines yellow. Dry 2–3 days in shade before storing in ventilated jute bags.

summary: High-altitude orchards; winter pruning and bagging improve grade.

guides.title: Winter pruning
guides.body: Prune crossing branches in Magh–Falgun. Apply lime wash on trunks. Apply FYM basins before bud break.

guides.title: Pollination
guides.body: Introduce bee hives or avoid spraying during bloom. Thin clusters to 1–2 fruits per spur.

guides.title: Bagging & nutrition
guides.body: Bag fruits 6 weeks after set to reduce scab. Foliar calcium reduces bitter pit.

guides.title: Maturity index
guides.body: Pick when starch clears on cut test. Store at 0–4°C with humidity 90% for export chains.

summary: Terai and inner Terai; manage hopper before flowering.

guides.title: Canopy management
guides.body: Open center after harvest. Remove water shoots. Apply boron spray 3 weeks before bloom if deficiency suspected.

guides.title: Hopper control
guides.body: Monitor inflorescence for hopper—sticky traps and timely botanical sprays protect fruit set.

guides.title: Irrigation
guides.body: Light irrigation during fruit swell. Avoid heavy nitrogen—it causes spongy tissue.

guides.title: Maturity
guides.body: Harvest when shoulder fills and sap reduces. Dip in hot water for anthracnose if shipping far.

summary: Clean milking, cooling within 2 hours, and balanced ration for buffaloes/cows.

guides.title: Balanced ration
guides.body: Provide green fodder + concentrate by body weight. Mineral mix improves fat %. Ensure 24/7 clean water.

guides.title: Routine
guides.body: Fixed morning/evening times. Strip fore-milk to check mastitis. Use stainless utensils only.

guides.title: Udder health
guides.body: Wash teats with lukewarm water, dry before milking. Post-dip iodine solution in wet season.

guides.title: Cool chain
guides.body: Cool to 4°C within 2 hours. Deliver to collection center same day for best price and safety.

summary: Culture consistency and temperature control define texture and shelf life.

guides.title: Standardize
guides.body: Boil fresh milk, cool to 45°C. Remove cream if skim dahi is required.

guides.title: Inoculation
guides.body: Add 2% previous batch culture. Use fresh culture weekly to avoid off-flavors.

guides.title: Set time
guides.body: Keep warm 4–6 hours without moving. Insulated pots work in hills; avoid drafts.

guides.title: Chill & sell
guides.body: Refrigerate after set. Market within 48 hours; label production date in Nepali calendar for trust.

summary: Monsoon transplant; maintain shallow standing water in vegetative stage.

guides.title: Seed rate
guides.body: Treat seeds; sow in raised nursery beds 25–30 days before monsoon onset.

guides.title: Spacing
guides.body: 2–3 seedlings per hill, 20×20 cm for fine varieties. Level fields for even water.

guides.title: Water & weeds
guides.body: 2–5 cm standing water; drain before top-dress urea. Manual weed at 25 and 45 DAT.

guides.title: Dry & store
guides.body: Harvest at 80% golden grains. Dry to 14% moisture before jute storage with neem leaves.

summary: Sow with first monsoon rain; nitrogen at knee-high stage.

guides.title: Population
guides.body: 45×25 cm spacing; one seed per hole. Apply phosphorus in planting furrow.

guides.title: Side dress N
guides.body: Urea when knee-high; second split at tasseling if soil is light.

guides.title: Pest watch
guides.body: Fall armyworm—check whorl weekly. Bird nets near maturity in kitchen gardens.

guides.title: Moisture
guides.body: Harvest cobs when husks dry; shell and sun-dry to 13% for storage.
